Not committed into trip-planner itself; move this file to trip-planner/.brain/resources.json when convenient so it becomes the project's own source of truth.

resources.name: Vercel
resources.purpose: Production hosting + deploys for the web app and serverless API routes (api/*). Production domain mytripfairy.com, plus the default <app>.vercel.app URL.
resources.plan: unverified — check the Vercel dashboard for current plan/limits
resources.notes: vercel.json defines API rewrites (/ai, /flights, /advisories, /climate → api/*). README references the Vercel URL for Turnstile domain allowlisting.

resources.name: Supabase
resources.purpose: Postgres database, auth, and cross-device sync. Server-side billing/metering (server/billing.mjs) calls SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with the service-role key; browser uses the anon key.
resources.notes: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is a fallback for SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY during migration to the newer sb_secret_ key format (server/billing.mjs). Billing/metering is only enforced once SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY are both set — otherwise the managed AI endpoint stays open/unmetered.

resources.name: GitHub
resources.purpose: Source control / repo host for trip-planner.
resources.notes: Repo remote not read by this scan (avoided running git remote -v outside the brief); verify the owner/repo URL directly.

resources.name: npm
resources.purpose: Publishes `trip-fairy-helper` (packages/helper/) — a CLI users run locally (`npx trip-fairy-helper`) to pair their own Claude Code session with the Trip Fairy website as a 'Your Claude Code' AI engine, no API key needed.
resources.notes: README.md documents the pairing-code flow; packages/helper/package.json confirms the published package name/version.

resources.name: Ignav
resources.purpose: Flight fare search/pricing (server/ignav.mjs, src/lib/fareOptimizer.js, src/lib/gateways.js) — airport search and fare sweeps for the flight-optimized planning feature.
resources.plan: unverified — check Ignav's own dashboard/plan for API limits
resources.notes: Base URL defaults to https://ignav.com/api (overridable via IGNAV_BASE_URL) per server/ignav.mjs.

resources.name: Open-Meteo
resources.purpose: Historical/climate weather data (server/climate.mjs) backing trip climate estimates.
resources.plan: free tier (public API); a customer/commercial archive endpoint is used when a key is configured
resources.notes: server/climate.mjs switches between archive-api.open-meteo.com (free) and customer-archive-api.open-meteo.com (keyed) depending on whether a key env var is set — exact key env var name not confirmed in this scan; verify in server/climate.mjs.

resources.name: Nominatim / OpenStreetMap
resources.purpose: Geocoding (place name → coordinates) used throughout trip planning (src/lib/geocode.js), including airport-to-stop distance for gateway selection.
resources.plan: free, subject to OSM Foundation's usage policy (rate limits, user-agent requirement)
resources.notes: src/lib/geocode.js references the usage policy directly and rate-limits/caches calls client-side.

resources.name: Wikipedia
resources.purpose: Destination photos + summaries (src/lib/images.js) via the REST summary API.

resources.name: Openverse
resources.purpose: Openly-licensed destination images (src/lib/images.js) as an image source alongside Wikipedia.

resources.name: Wikivoyage
resources.purpose: Destination guide text (src/lib/wikivoyage.js), CC BY-SA licensed.

resources.name: Anthropic
resources.purpose: Managed AI trip-planning (api/ai/plan.js, server/llm.mjs, src/lib/aiClient.js) when the user hasn't paired their own Claude Code via trip-fairy-helper. Gated by server-side billing/metering once Supabase billing env vars are set.
resources.notes: server/llm.mjs also supports a Vercel AI Gateway path (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY / AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL, default https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh) as an alternative managed-AI routing option — treat as part of the same 'managed AI' resource.

resources.name: Lemon Squeezy
resources.purpose: Payments for AI-credit packs — webhook handler at api/webhooks/lemonsqueezy.js verifies LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and credits Supabase-tracked balances (LS_PACKS env configures pack → credits mapping).
resources.plan: unverified — check Lemon Squeezy dashboard for store/plan details
resources.notes: Verified by the presence of api/webhooks/lemonsqueezy.js and the server/.env.example var names; did not confirm the live store is active/selling.

resources.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
resources.purpose: Bot-check widget (src/lib/captcha.js) loaded from Cloudflare's challenges.cloudflare.com script; README documents configuring the widget's allowed domains (mytripfairy.com + the Vercel URL).
resources.notes: Marked dormant per the task brief — VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY is present but empty in both .env and .env.example in this scan, so the widget appears wired but not currently keyed/active. Verify directly before relying on this.
